The failing step is the "no plan, configured shell missing" check. The gate appends `shell = "pwsh"` to the config that `vloop init` wrote, and that config ends in a `[metrics]` table. If that one gate line writes `shell = "pwsh"` before the existing config instead of appending it, the whole gate passes. I checked this on a patched copy and it printed `gate T8 ok`. I did not touch the real gate.
